photos.caption: waking up in a hotel room, big window with a bright morning view of the Busan sea, ships and a cable car, sunlight on white sheets
walking along Songdo beach, wide sandy beach, tall glass towers, dramatic clouds, sea breeze
a cosy Korean breakfast: seaweed soup bubbling in a black stone pot, a pot of rice and little side dishes
the fish market: big glass tanks full of king crabs and snow crabs, bright blue water
a feast of soy-marinated raw crab (ganjang gejang) with green chilli, a bowl of rice with egg yolk and roe, side dishes
a Korean street-food stall: crispy fried chicken skin piled high and corn dogs, glowing red-and-black signs
Nampo-dong shopping street at dusk, neon signs, crowds, a deep blue evening sky
a huge plate of Korean fried chicken, glossy soy-garlic and spicy green-chilli sauces
sweet shrimp on ice, fresh sea urchin, crispy fried shrimp heads and a little stew pot on a fire
a small stew pot over a candle flame at night, glazed shrimp and grilled tofu, a cold glass of fizzy drink
a steaming bowl of Busan pork-and-rice soup (dwaeji gukbap), sliced pork, chives and lettuce
spicy soft tofu stew bubbling red in a stone pot, purple rice in a hot stone bowl
back home: a bowl of mixed noodles with chashu and a rice box, a happy last meal of the trip
